content.short: Rad TV is a Web3 video streaming and creator platform with apps on major streaming devices.
content.description: Rad TV enables minting and streaming large videos on chain, allowing creators to build channels and stream to audiences worldwide, while viewers can buy from their favorite creators. Minted videos can be watched on a broad range of devices, including Apple TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, iPhone, Android Mobile, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, VR, VR2, and Meta Quest, providing flexible viewing options across living rooms and mobile setups.
